title: Grateful Dead Live at The Spectrum on 1982-04-06
source: flac16/48kHz; Source Info: Jim Wise's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi 700 mics > Bob Wagner's Sony TC-D5M > Jim's Sony TC-D5M (Maxell UDXLII-C90)Transfer Info:Master Cassettes (Nakamichi Dragon)> Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6 MHz) > dBpoweramp (24-bit/96 kHz) > Adobe Audition 3.01 (24-bit/96 kHz) > TLH flac2496; 24-bit > 16-bit via dBpoweramp

ai_review.summary: Audience‑sourced tape delivers a high‑energy early‑80s show with crisp crowd vibe; Wise’s fresh cassette transfer makes it a standout despite the lack of a soundboard source.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the new audience/PA recording, praising Jim Wise’s clean cassette-to‑FLAC transfer and the palpable crowd energy that drives the performance. The set is described as a rocking first set followed by an over‑the‑top second set with classic ’70s verve, making the show enjoyable even without specific song highlights.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviews give 5 stars and focus on a strong performance and good audience recording; limited to two reviews, so confidence is low despite consistency.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Fresh cassette transfer by Jim Wise, clear crowd ambience, decent mix; reviewers note it outshines the mediocre soundboard source.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set described as a straight‑ahead rocker reminiscent of the late ’70s; second set “over the top” with high energy and a post‑space that feels like classic ‘70s material, keeping the crowd engaged throughout.
